emptyHistory: No user messages in this conversation.
branchExplanation: Creates a new branch from before this message and sends the updated text.
noMessageDescription: Continue directly from the existing history without adding a user message.
promptDescription: Send a visible continuation prompt to the agent.
navigationFailed: The branch was created, but could not be opened automatically.
plainTextOnly: Editing and retrying currently support plain-text user messages.
error.forbidden: Only the host owner can perform this action.
error.unsupported-runtime: This DSH version is not supported by the plugin.
error.message-not-editable: This message cannot be edited or retried.
error.session-changed: The conversation changed before this action could start. Try again.
error.source-running: Wait for this conversation to stop before continuing.
error.queue-pending: Handle the pending message queue before continuing.
error.not-resumable: There is no interrupted or incomplete task available to continue.
error.continuation-unsupported: Direct continuation is unavailable here. You can send a continuation message instead.
error.migration-required: Open this conversation in DSH to complete its migration first.
error.empty-message: Enter some message text before submitting.
error.transport: Request failed. Check your connection and try again.
error.archived: Restore this conversation from the archive before continuing.
error.generic: The action could not be completed.
error.no-context: There is no recorded context to continue.
error.input-not-admitted: The original input was stopped before entering history. Retry that message instead.
error.unresolved-tools: The history has unresolved tool calls and cannot continue directly.
error.unsupported-tail: The history does not end in a supported state for direct continuation.
error.partial-replay-unavailable: The interrupted response cannot be replayed directly by this model.
error.model-disabled: Direct continuation without a new message is disabled for this model.
error.owned-session: This conversation is controlled by another agent.
error.attachments-not-supported: Messages with attachments cannot be edited or retried.
error.message-too-large: This message exceeds the maximum length limit.
error.workspace-required: This conversation has no recorded working directory.
error.workspace-missing: The branch was created, but its workspace is no longer available.
error.unsupported-format: This conversation format is not supported.
error.host-error: The host could not complete the operation.
